data.description: User-level JSON settings outside project databases for window geometry, known projects, and active project selection. Missing or empty settings are a recoverable onboarding state and must not create a synthetic default project. Backend choice belongs to the portable project descriptor, not a duplicate setting here. Local registrations, checkout paths, window state, templates and future connection profile/secret references remain user-specific. Successful reads must not rewrite this file; invalid input must not overwrite the user's project registrations.
data.name: App Settings Store
